limitations: Chromium headless/Linux; responsive viewports, not physical phone hardware.
Speech policy uses controlled mocks; actual Arabic speech hardware/pack not tested.
Worker failure and watchdog use controlled faults.
OCR uses a real printed fixture; arbitrary handwriting is not guaranteed.
Complex integer powers |n|<=10^12; roots n<=32; trigonometric identities n<=12.
Probability workbench is bounded: urn draws<=32, colors<=8, discrete-law values<=100, joint law<=10x10, mixtures<=8 branches.
Exact rational arithmetic is bounded; binomial and normal distributions use finite-precision approximations. Underflow does not imply a mathematically impossible event or a verified zero variance.
Independent numerical checks are not proofs; unsupported or ambiguous cases ask for clarification.
Textbook and dialect support is rule-based and bounded, not a guarantee for all wording or dialects. Missing or ambiguous data still requires clarification.
Textbook image test uses real local OCR followed by explicit human review/correction. The radical was recognized as Vv3 in the printed fixture; mathematical OCR is not assumed infallible.
Spatial geometry assumes an orthonormal frame for metric formulas; a nonorthonormal frame without Gram data is not silently treated as orthonormal.

Spatial algebra is bounded: at most three radical primes/eight terms; finite inputs up to 1e9; drawing values up to 1e12. Unsupported nested radicals and excess expression complexity require clarification.
Spatial diagrams are projections, not geometric proofs. Vector/matrix bridges preserve the bounded exact coordinate models; approximate eigenvalues remain supplemental and unverified.
Curriculum conformity is not certified: official catalog access did not provide a complete verified ministry textbook edition.
School proofs are bounded: affine closed-form induction, selected geometric criteria, and polynomial IVT/monotonicity. Not a general proof or full function-study engine.
School corpus includes 18 expected clarifications and one partial success; passing these tests does not imply support for their unsupported mathematical topics.

Matrix input: dimensions 1–6, up to 12 named matrices, 500 characters/cell. Matrix expressions: 300 characters, 120 tokens, nesting 20, powers −1…12. Exact rational/simple-radical arithmetic is bounded, not a general symbolic matrix algebra system.
Matrix school-style methods do not certify that these topics occur in an unverified official ministry textbook edition. The 64-case matrix corpus expects 9 clarifications.
All tool categories and reference details start collapsed. Examples/editing do not solve; a probability preview has its own explicit calculation action and is invalidated when its inputs change.
